⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the AIN app connect flow never passes `supportsImages` — the added parameter is inert, the onboarding config still derives vision from the name heuristic**

`_registerAiinProvider` gained `bool? supportsImages` and forwards it into the reconnect config, but its only call site (`_finishAiinConnect`, `aiin_connect_flow.dart:736-745`) does not pass it, and `_pickAiinModel` returns only the chosen id — the `/v1/models` payload (with its `input_modalities`) is discarded at `aiin_connect_flow.dart:829` (`.$1`). So a user onboarding through the AIN connect flow who picks a heuristic-invisible multimodal id (`mistralai/mistral-large-4-0`, `meta/muse-*`) still gets `supportsImages: null` → `modelIdSuggestsVision` heuristic → the image-attachment lock gh-2466(2) targets stays locked on this surface.

The PR description lists "AgentConfig.supportsImages in the AIN app flow" among the wired surfaces — as shipped, only the settings form's custom-provider flow (`settings_flows.dart:386`, covered by `flutter_app/test/endpoint_modalities_vision_test.dart`) and the pickers derive vision from endpoint modalities.

**Fix**: return the fetched info from the model pick (or re-look the id up in `fetchModelsForEndpoint(aiinDefaultChatBaseUrl).$4`) and pass `modalities[modelId]?.contains('image')` into `_registerAiinProvider`; add the connect-flow case to `flutter_app/test/endpoint_modalities_vision_test.dart`.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the `supportsImages` doc comment states the opposite of the implemented precedence**

The doc says *"a false NEVER overrides a heuristic true — an endpoint that answers modalities at all is more specific than a name matcher"*, but the implementation below does exactly the override it forbids:

```dart
bool get visionCapable =>
    supportsImages ?? modelIdSuggestsVision(modelId);
```

With `supportsImages == false` (endpoint reported `[text]`), `??` returns `false` — overriding a heuristic `true` (e.g. `gpt-4o`-shaped ids). Every other surface in this PR implements endpoint-wins-**including-false**: `settings.dart::_onModelIdChanged` ("a reported text-only list unchecks it"), the CLI's `_switchInputModalities`, and the PR description itself ("prefer endpoint modalities with the heuristic as fallback"). So the code is right and the comment is wrong — and this precedence is the crux rule of gh-2466, so the next reader may "fix" the code to match the comment and invert it.

**Fix**: reword the doc to "a reported verdict wins (true *or* false); only `null` falls back to the id heuristic."

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
**Fixed** — the modality cache is now cleared at every provider/session reset point, and the switch flows can no longer bake a previous provider's verdict into the model they build.

**The five reset points** (six blocks — `_switchProvider` has two), mirroring the `_modelContextWindows`/`_modelMaxTokens` siblings:

- `lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart:1381` (`_switchToCustomModel`)
- `lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart:2069` and `:2108` (`_switchProvider`, roles + non-roles branches)
- `lib/src/cli/codemie_provider_commands.dart:372`
- `lib/src/cli/provider_codemie_sso.dart:207`
- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:1994` (`_finishRestoreBinding`)

**Build-before-reset ordering**: in three flows the switch builds the `Model` (via `_switchInputModalities`) *before* the reset, so clearing after the build would only have protected *later* switches — the switch's own model would still carry the stale verdict. The clear block now runs before `buildCatalogModel` in `_switchProvider` (non-roles branch), `codemie_provider_commands.dart`, and `provider_codemie_sso.dart` (the catalog builder is pure — it reads no CLI caches — so the move is side-effect free; `_refreshModelCache()` stays after the model assignment, as it must).

**The `isNotEmpty` guard is kept deliberately** (the reviewer's "and/or" — the resets are the sufficient half): `_fetchOpenAiCompatibleModels` (and `_fetchCopilotModelsAndLimits`) is also the fetch path for *other* saved and env-keyed providers during the cross-provider `/models` refresh. Making the assignment unconditional there would let a modality-less endpoint's background answer wipe the *active* provider's verdicts mid-session — the same leak class in the opposite direction. With the resets in place the guard is safe: a stale verdict cannot outlive the provider switch (the map is cleared at the switch), and a same-endpoint re-fetch re-reports the same data.

**Regression test** (TDD, red before the fix): `test/cli/aiin_models_switch_test.dart` — *"a provider switch drops the previous provider modality verdicts"* — boots on the AIN answer (`mistralai/mistral-large-4-0` → `[text, image]`), takes the id on AIN, then switches to a modality-less plain endpoint whose list shares the same id and asserts the rebuilt model and a subsequent `/model` pick both carry the heuristic's `['text']`. Before the fix it failed exactly as the thread's repro predicts (`['text', 'image']` baked into the switched-to model); after the fix it passes, alongside the full CLI provider/restore suites.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the AIN endpoint's vision verdict is session-scoped on the app surface — it is lost at the next boot, and the image-attachment lock gh-2466(2) targets re-locks**

This hunk correctly threads the endpoint's modalities verdict into the onboarding `AgentConfig` — but the verdict lives only in the in-memory config. Nothing persists it, and nothing re-derives it from the endpoint at boot:

- `LastConnection` has no `supportsImages` field (`flutter_app/lib/services/last_connection.dart` — the record carries only `providerKind`/`modelId`/`baseUrl`/preset ids), so `saveFromConfig` drops the verdict on the floor.
- The boot restore re-derives vision from the id heuristic: `boot_config_codec.dart:96-98` — `AgentConfig(..., supportsImages: modelIdSuggestsVision(connection.modelId))`.
- Nothing fetches `/models` at boot (`EndpointModelsController.inputModalities` populates only when the settings screen loads its list).
- The restored heuristic-only verdict gates image input: `agent_service.dart:659-661` (`_config?.supportsImages ?? modelIdSuggestsVision(...)`) → the main-connection vision gate in `video_tool.dart:193-198` (no vision-slot override ⇒ `fromOverride: false` ⇒ the main model is checked). Session restore has the same gap: `agent_service_sessions.dart:470` rebuilds with `input: inputModalitiesFor(sessionModel.modelId)` (heuristic only).

Net effect for the PR's flagship id: connect with `mistralai/mistral-large-4-0` (endpoint-reported `[text, image]`) → images work → restart the app → attach an image → *"The connected model does not accept images"*. Ticket AC 2 ("the image-attachment UX unlocks for those models") holds only within the session. The CLI does not have this gap: its boot cache-warm re-fetches `/models`, so `_modelInputModalities` repopulates from the live endpoint every session.

**Fix**: persist the verdict — add `supportsImages` to `LastConnection.toJson`/`fromJson` + `fromConfig`, and have `_restore` prefer the persisted verdict with the id heuristic as fallback (`supportsImages: connection.supportsImages ?? modelIdSuggestsVision(connection.modelId)`). A boot-time `/models` re-fetch would also close `agent_service_sessions.dart:470`, but the persisted field is the minimal change. The existing two connect-flow widget tests cover the in-session half; a restore round-trip assertion would cover the new field.

# ⚠️ session-scoped vision verdict → persisted in `LastConnection`

**Fixed** — the verdict now survives the boot boundary; the image-attachment lock no longer re-locks at restart.

- `LastConnection` carries `bool? supportsImages` (`flutter_app/lib/services/last_connection.dart`): captured in `fromConfig` (`config.supportsImages` — the connect flow's threaded endpoint verdict reaches the record), parsed in `fromJson` (`as bool?` — a legacy record without the field restores `null`), and persisted conditionally in `toJson` (no explicit nulls, matching the record's absent-fields-stay-absent convention). The field doc states the rule: a persisted verdict wins true *or* false; only `null` falls back to the heuristic.
- `_restore` (`flutter_app/lib/boot/boot_config_codec.dart:98`) now reads `supportsImages: connection.supportsImages ?? modelIdSuggestsVision(connection.modelId)` — the persisted verdict (true *or* false) beats the id heuristic; legacy records keep the pre-change behavior.
- `agent_service_sessions.dart:470` (the session-restore rebuild) is left as is per the thread's own "optional" note — it covers continuing an in-flight session, while the boot path (the reported repro: connect → restart → attach) is the one the persisted field closes. A boot `/models` re-fetch would be the heavier alternative; not taken here to keep the change minimal.

**Tests (TDD — red before the fix)**: a 5-case group in `flutter_app/test/endpoint_modalities_vision_test.dart` ("boot restore keeps the persisted vision verdict"):

1. `fromConfig` + `toJson`/`fromJson` round-trip for the flagship id (`mistralai/mistral-large-4-0`, verdict `true`) and a text-only verdict (`false`) — before the fix this failed to compile ("No named parameter with the name 'supportsImages'"), which is the finding: nothing persisted the verdict.
2. a legacy record (no field in the JSON) restores `supportsImages: null` — the heuristic keeps owning old records;
3. `restorableBootConfig` prefers the persisted `true` over the heuristic (the reported repro's fix assertion: heuristic says text-only, restore boots vision-capable);
4. a persisted `false` wins over a heuristic-matching id (`gpt-4o-2024-11-20`) — endpoint-wins-including-false holds across the boot boundary too;
5. a legacy record falls back to the heuristic (`gpt-4o-2024-11-20` → `true`).

All five pass, alongside the file's existing two connect-flow widget cases.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: `_modelInputModalities` survives provider switches — stale cross-provider modality verdicts are applied at `/model` switches**

The new cache is only overwritten when the *new* endpoint reports modalities — `if (modalities.isNotEmpty) _modelInputModalities = modalities;` here and in `_fetchCopilotModels` (`provider_models.dart:951`) — so an endpoint that answers without modality metadata (plain OpenAI-compatible, CodeMie, Copilot — the Copilot dialect always returns an empty modality map) leaves the *previous* provider's map in place. And no provider/session switch clears it: five reset sites clear the sibling caches with the comment "The cached model list belongs to the previous provider/endpoint" and `_modelInputModalities` is missing from all of them:

- `lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart:1379-1381`
- `lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart:2066-2067` and `:2126-2127`
- `lib/src/cli/codemie_provider_commands.dart:381-382`
- `lib/src/cli/provider_codemie_sso.dart:224-225`
- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:1992-1993`

`_switchInputModalities` (`provider_models.dart:1047`) then consults the stale map *first*.

**Repro**: connect AIN (`/models` reports `claude-* → [text,image]`) → switch to an endpoint without modality fields whose list shares any id with the AIN answer (gateways commonly proxy the same upstream ids) → `/model <id>` saves the model with the AIN verdict's `input` modalities. Wrong `input` on the active model is exactly the defect class gh-2466 fixes — reintroduced via provider switching.

**Fix**: clear `_modelInputModalities = const {}` at the five reset points (mirroring `_modelContextWindows`/`_modelMaxTokens`), and/or drop the `isNotEmpty` guard in `_fetchOpenAiCompatibleModels` so a fresh answer always replaces the map (that path already assigns windows/caps unconditionally).
